overview: Discovery of legacy state and phased migration to the selected platform with validated rollback and reconciliation. The scope is built around asset or device telemetry, calibration certificates and field SOPs, producing validated sensing pipeline, alert playbooks and field acceptance. A customer-named operational technology lead approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is sensor failure and worker or facility safety.
